remarks: Welcome to this Lovely 3/4 Bedroom 2.5 Bath home that has been recently updated and painted throughout. Situated in a quiet neighborhood in the sought after Wolfpitt area. Open and spacious Floor plan with large updated Kitchen with granite, s/s appliances and white cabinetry. The Primary suite has vaulted ceilings, large closet, loft and a spacious full Bath with jetted jacuzzi. The suite also has an additional room that could be used as an office, gym or nursery. There is an upstairs laundry room for added convenience. Recently refinished hardwood floors throughout 2nd level. Enjoy the beautiful extended back deck ( 40x14) and professionally landscaped yard. Close to shopping, public transportation and beaches!
